scoring_justification: Recomputing from raw DFT/BoltzTraP artifacts is infeasible; scoring uses paper-reported reference values with tolerances and trend/ordering checks.

outputs.description: Scored structural and magnetic properties: lattice constant, bulk modulus, formation enthalpy, total magnetic moment, and exchange constants for HgCr2S4 and HgCr2Se4. The hidden reference consists of paper‑reported values with domain‑appropriate tolerances.

Scored transport coefficients: Seebeck coefficient and power factor at 200, 400, 600 K for HgCr2S4 and HgCr2Se4. The hidden reference includes digitized graph values and required monotonic trends and compound ordering.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are re‑derivable from the agent's own DFT and Boltzmann transport runs. The scoring tolerances and trend checks are hidden.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference structural/magnetic properties for HgCr2S4 and HgCr2Se4
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (a0, B0, ΔHf), Table 2 (magnetic moment), Table 3 (exchange constants N0α, N0β).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from published tables and values mentioned in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's primary reported quantities for the two compounds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Seebeck coefficient and approximate power factor values at 200,400,600 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Seebeck coefficients digitized from Fig. 6b; power factor values approximated from Fig. 6d and text description.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from the published figures and cross-checked with the qualitative descriptions in the text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Needed to evaluate the transport headlineresult; values are consistent with the paper's trends and ordering.

steps.description: Compare a0, B0, ΔHf, total magnetic moment, N0α, N0β to paper-reported values with tolerances: ±0.2Å, ±20GPa, ±0.2eV, ±0.5μB, ±0.1eV, ±0.1eV.
Check Seebeck coefficient within ±30 μV/K of digitized gold, monotonic increase with temperature, compound ordering (HgCr2S4 > HgCr2Se4), and power factor monotonicity and ordering at 600K.
